question: What does an angry being destroy in the triple world?
premises: kruddhaḥ tu saṃharet means when angry he destroys
sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ is all triple world
sa cara acaram includes moving and unmoving
inference: When angry, he destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
